author: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
html:
It seems that the link to www.justaddwater.dk creates a circular trackback. Very funny!

It reminds me of a story: Once I had a boss that wanted to test the auto-reply of his email program. This was roughly 8 years ago, and email applications were still a bit rough on the edges.

He sent a mail to himself to test the auto-reply, and went on holidays. A few hours later, the data manager contacted him. He had 80.000 emails in his mailbox and that it filled up the harddisk. Hehe, so amazing that this email program actually was a real product:

Lotus Notes!
